displayClear.rules: 0/1 clear annulus display family; 2/3 clear rectangle display family. Same-family whole/parameters retains other same-family fields; CustomVisible=false clears all13 displayed values.
displayClear.evidenceBoundary: SetValueNull only writes CurValueA=null; ButtonSelecter change notification requires old and new both nonnull. Persistent reference deletion NOT proved. Do not equate presentation clearing with accepted reference deletion.

groupPrimitive: TrySetGroup optional validatePrepared runs once after all values frozen, before same-value test/writer. Single TrySet moves own validator into always callback; do not automatically reapply old per-field validators to Range, which already owns simultaneous two-DP candidate binding validation. FieldsView TrySetFields supplies pure full-candidate group validation, one writer; unknown IDs rejected before mutation.
owner: writeDraft validates expected immutable root, installs full fields/local geometry+revision without notifications. After all states accepted, owner Changed calls Session.Refresh; exceptions are post-accept observer failures. Never Refresh inside writer. Read disabled local geometry for inherited modes preserving Group+Guid; geometry proposal compares same current revision.
